name: Guild Issue Sword
description: A F-rank sword for the main hand. +8 ATK.
flavor: Free with registration. You get what you pay for.

name: Hollis's Practice Blade
description: An E-rank sword for the main hand. +22 ATK, +3% crit chance.
flavor: Bent from a thousand swings. Still true.

name: Grukk's Cleaver
description: An E-rank greatsword for the main hand. +30 ATK, +25% damage to goblinoids.
flavor: He named it "Hungry." It was.

name: Guild Rookie Hood
description: A F-rank light armour piece for the head slot. +3 DEF.
flavor: Brown leather, a little too big. Everyone's first hood.

name: Minor Healing Potion
description: Restores 120 HP.
flavor: Tastes like mint and regret.

name: Silver Wolf Pelt
description: A moon-silver pelt from a legendary wolf. Tailors and hunters will pay for the right to hold it.
flavor: It still glows faintly under the moon.

name: Moonfang Dagger
description: A C-rank pair of daggers for the main hand. +64 ATK, +50% crit damage at night.
flavor: One fang for revenge, one for mercy.

name: Oak Guild Card
description: Your Guild registration card in plain oak. It records your name, your rank and every board you have worked.
flavor: Rank F. Burned stamp. Your name, spelled almost right.

name: Healing Herb
description: A bitter green herb. Fennick turns it into the base of most potions, and so can you.
flavor: Smells like mint. Fennick will tell you if you picked the wrong one.

name: Mina's Silver Earring
description: A small silver earring belonging to Mina, kept safe for her. A quest item; it cannot be sold.
flavor: A gift from her sister. She'll pretend it's not important.

name: Rookie's Pouch
description: A belt pouch that carries three potions in neat loops. Sized for a beginner who plans to survive.
flavor: Holds three potions and a lot of hope.

name: Copper Compass
description: A pocket compass with a copper face. Its needle favours the nearest open quest marker over true north.
flavor: Points to the nearest unfinished promise.

name: Fire Bomb
description: A clay bomb packed with sap and core dust. Throw it to deal Fire damage in a small burst.
flavor: Throw it at something you don't like. Ring 0's Firestorm starter.

name: Mandrake Root
description: A knobbly root with a face almost like yours. A key ingredient for potent healing draughts.
flavor: Still screaming, very quietly.

name: Guild Issue Mace & Buckler
description: A F-rank mace for the main hand. +6 ATK, +4 DEF.
flavor: Heavy enough to matter, light enough to lift all day.

name: Guild Issue Staff
description: A F-rank staff for the main hand. +8 MATK.
flavor: The crystal is glass. The intent is real.

name: Guild Issue Censer
description: A F-rank censer for the main hand. +5 MATK, +3 MDEF.
flavor: Smells of cheap incense and good intentions.

name: Guild Issue Daggers
description: A F-rank pair of daggers for the main hand. +6 ATK, +3% crit chance.
flavor: A matched pair. Mostly matched.

name: Guild Issue Shortbow
description: A F-rank shortbow for the main hand. +7 ATK.
flavor: The string is new. The bow remembers other hands.

name: Guild Issue Whip
description: A F-rank whip for the main hand. +5 ATK, +1 CHA.
flavor: Mostly for making a noise. Monsters respect a good noise.

name: Guild Issue Smithing Hammer
description: A F-rank smithing hammer for the main hand. +7 ATK.
flavor: Drives nails. Also goblins.

name: Guild Issue Spear
description: A F-rank spear for the main hand. +8 ATK.
flavor: Long enough to keep a goblin honest.

name: Guild Issue Hand Wraps
description: A F-rank pair of hand wraps for the main hand. +5 ATK, +4 speed.
flavor: Cloth, tape and a strong suggestion.

name: Guild Issue Lute
description: A F-rank lute for the main hand. +5 MATK, +2 CHA.
flavor: Three strings in tune. The fourth has opinions.

name: Unmarked Grimoire
description: A F-rank grimoire for the main hand. +8 MATK.
flavor: The guild sells it without asking what you will write in it.

name: Fangblade
description: A F-rank sword for the main hand. +12 ATK.
flavor: A goblin blade, re-edged with wolf fangs along the spine.

name: Carapace Cap
description: A F-rank light armour piece for the head slot. +5 DEF.
flavor: Beetle plates riveted to a fur lining. Smells like a forest floor.

name: Talon Charm
description: A charm of crow talons and feathers. Slightly raises your chance to land a critical hit.
flavor: Crow talons bound with feather and a sliver of core. Lucky, they say.

name: Hunter's Skewer
description: Fire-seared monster meat on a stick. Restores HP and is the best thing you can eat on the road.
flavor: Prime meat, campfire-charred. The best meal in Whisperwood is the one you cooked yourself.

name: Ironbound Mace
description: An E-rank mace for the main hand. +15 ATK, +4 DEF.
flavor: Crude iron bands around a boar tusk. It settles arguments.

name: Bronze Greaves
description: A D-rank medium armour piece for the legs slot. +11 DEF.
flavor: Labyrinth bronze, beaten thin enough to walk in.

name: Cursed Iron Blade
description: A C-rank sword for the main hand. +44 ATK, +3% crit chance.
flavor: The iron hums when the lanterns go out. Brannoc says that is only the cooling.

name: Mythic Horn Lance
description: A B-rank spear for the main hand. +56 ATK.
flavor: A single horn, drawn out and set on a long shaft. It is lighter than it has any right to be.

name: Pearl Band
description: A plain band set with a river pearl. A little extra magic attack for caster hands.
flavor: A river pearl in a plain band. Warm when someone is thinking of you.

name: Fanged Amulet
description: A rough leather cord strung with fangs and a tusk chip. Adds a little attack for those who wear it proudly.
flavor: Three fangs and a tusk chip on a leather cord. Plain, sturdy, a little proud.

name: Temple Gold Signet
description: A thick ring of temple gold. It adds defence and magic defence in equal measure.
flavor: Temple gold rolled into a ring. It carries a faint memory of bells.

name: Healing Potion
description: A standard healing draught. Restores a good chunk of HP in a single swallow.
flavor: Fennick keeps the second batch for people who promise to come back.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: A deep green restorative with real weight behind it. Restores a large amount of HP.
flavor: Deep green and slow to pour. It smells of a whole meadow.

name: Leather Cap
description: A F-rank light armour piece for the head slot. +4 DEF.
flavor: Stitched in the tannery shed by someone who wanted you home for supper.

name: Hunter Jerkin
description: A F-rank light armour piece for the chest slot. +6 DEF.
flavor: Pelt and a fang for luck. It remembers the forest.

name: Giant Hide Boots
description: An E-rank light armour piece for the feet slot. +8 DEF.
flavor: Thick enough for stones, soft enough for a long road.

name: Shadehide Cloak
description: A D-rank light armour piece for the back slot. +5 DEF, +6 MDEF.
flavor: Cursed fur, calmed with shade essence. It only looks like it is watching you.

name: Serpent Scale Jerkin
description: A C-rank light armour piece for the chest slot. +20 DEF.
flavor: Overlapping scales over horsehair padding. It flexes like a held breath.

name: Silk Hood
description: A F-rank cloth armour piece for the head slot. +2 DEF, +3 MDEF.
flavor: Light, close-fitting and surprisingly warm.

name: Apprentice Robe
description: A F-rank cloth armour piece for the chest slot. +3 DEF, +5 MDEF.
flavor: Ines tucks a scrap of spirit paper into the hem. For luck, she says.

name: Inkwell Dye
description: A pot of blue-black dye for any garment. Cosmetic only; it changes colour, never stats.
flavor: Deep blue-black, and a little goes a long way. A cosmetic dye for any outfit.

name: Nightveil Hood
description: An E-rank cloth armour piece for the head slot. +3 DEF, +7 MDEF.
flavor: Silk with a night shard woven in. Evenings feel kinder under it.

name: Hexwarden Robe
description: A D-rank cloth armour piece for the chest slot. +6 DEF, +12 MDEF.
flavor: Cursed fur lined with silk, tamed and quiet. It keeps odd draughts off.

name: Mushroom Skewer
description: Roasted spore caps on a skewer. A modest, earthy meal that restores a little HP.
flavor: Spore caps and a leaf of healing herb over the coals. Earthy and kind.

name: Tail Roast
description: Slow-roasted tail meat. Restores a fair amount of HP and tastes best too hot.
flavor: Slow-roasted until the edges crackle. Best eaten while still too hot.

name: Hearth Stew
description: Marta's stew, thick with meat and seed. A filling meal at the Sleeping Griffon hearth.
flavor: Marta ladle, Marta pot, and a seat by the fire.

name: Hearth Loaf
description: A warm loaf from the Sleeping Griffon ovens. A light, comforting bite.
flavor: Crusty, golden and still warm. Hugo swears the oven does half the work.

name: Tuskroast Platter
description: A full platter of roast tusker with spore caps. A big meal for a big day.
flavor: A proper sit-down meal. Someone always asks for seconds.

name: Hearth Ale
description: A mild golden ale from the Griffon cellar. Barely a meal, but it eases the road.
flavor: Golden, mild and made in the cellar under the Sleeping Griffon.

name: Brimstone Bitters
description: A sharp, warming drink with a pinch of brimstone. Sip it; it is for the nerves more than the stomach.
flavor: A pinch of brimstone for a warm chest and a bright mind. Sip slowly.

name: Ember Rune
description: A rune of heat cut in Khazdur script. Socket it to give a weapon a warm, fiery edge.
flavor: A Khazdur glyph for heat, cut small enough to hold in a palm.

name: Tide Rune
description: A rune of cool, flowing water. Socket it to carry a cooling touch into your gear.
flavor: Cool to the touch even beside a forge.

name: Stone Rune
description: A rune of weight and endurance. Socket it to steady a piece of armour or a blade.
flavor: Heavy for its size. Dwarves say it remembers being a mountain.

name: Anvil Rune
description: The first rune every dwarven apprentice learns. Socket it to improve how well gear takes upgrades.
flavor: The first glyph an apprentice learns to strike.

name: Hearth Rune
description: A rune of warmth and shelter. Socket it to sharpen recovery and comfort.
flavor: Warm, and faintly smells of bread.

name: Gale Rune
description: A rune that hums when the wind turns. Socket it for speed and a lighter step.
flavor: It hums when the wind turns.

name: Scroll of Emberbrand
description: A scroll that sears a protective brand of heat into gear. Reads like a glowing coal.
flavor: Ink that glows like a banked coal.

name: Scroll of Wardweave
description: A knotted ward meant to be worn rather than read. Binds to armour and turns small hexes.
flavor: A tight knot of lines, meant to be worn, not read.

name: Scroll of Vitality
description: A scroll of healing herbs and steady breath. Binds to gear to improve vitality.
flavor: Smells of crushed herbs.

name: Scroll of Nightstep
description: A scroll whose ink shows only in shadow. Binds to gear to quieten your steps.
flavor: The ink only shows in shadow.

name: Scroll of Stormthread
description: A scroll that tingles in the hand. Binds a thread of lightning to your gear.
flavor: The paper tingles when you hold it.

name: Scrap Blade
description: A blade blank hammered from scrap. Combine with a hilt at a forge to make a weapon.
flavor: A blade blank hammered out of salvage.

name: Iron Blade
description: A clean iron blade blank. Combine with a hilt at a forge for a sturdier weapon.
flavor: Clean steel, waiting for a hilt.

name: Pelt-Wrapped Hilt
description: A hilt wrapped in wolf pelt. Pair with a blade at a forge for a comfortable grip.
flavor: Wolf pelt, wound tight and stitched.

name: Fang-Capped Hilt
description: A hilt capped with a fang. Pair with a blade at a forge for a sharper-looking sword.
flavor: A hilt with a fang for a pommel.

name: Tempered Shortsword
description: A F-rank sword for the main hand. +11 ATK.
flavor: Two good parts, fitted by someone who cared.

name: Ironwrought Longsword
description: An E-rank sword for the main hand. +20 ATK.
flavor: Balanced on the finger, the way Torvald checks them.

name: Healing Herb Seeds
description: Seeds for healing herb. Plant them in your garden; ready in a few days.
flavor: Tiny and dry. Plant them in good dirt and be patient.

name: Wheat Seeds
description: Wheat seeds. Plant them in your garden; they grow into wheat sheaves for bread and ale.
flavor: A pinch of gold in a paper twist.

name: Turnip Seeds
description: Turnip seeds. The easiest crop to grow, and the best one to start with.
flavor: The easiest thing in the world to grow.

name: Mandrake Seeds
description: Mandrake seeds. Slow to grow and noisy in the night, but valuable at harvest.
flavor: Plant them gently. The mandrake grumbles in its sleep.

name: Wheat Sheaf
description: A bundle of ripe wheat heads. Mill it into flour or brew it into ale.
flavor: Heavy heads, sweet smell.

name: Turnip
description: A round, pale turnip fresh from the ground. Eat it, mash it, or put it in the stew.
flavor: Round, pale, honest.

name: Turnip Mash
description: Mashed turnip with butter. A simple, cheerful dish that restores a little HP.
flavor: Butter helps. Salt helps more.

name: Garden Stew
description: A stew made entirely from your own garden. Restores HP and tastes like pride.
flavor: Everything in it came from your own dirt.

name: Harvest Ale
description: A light ale made from your own wheat. A modest pick-me-up with a farmer's pride.
flavor: Wheat, patience and a barrel.

name: Covenant tablet, upper half
description: The upper half of a broken covenant tablet. The writing is old Guild script; the lower half must be somewhere.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Covenant tablet, lower half
description: The lower half of a broken covenant tablet. It ends mid-sentence, as if the writer was interrupted.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Foundation plate, left edge
description: The left edge of a foundation plate from a dungeon's heart. Its other edge would fit like a key in a lock.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Foundation plate, right edge
description: The right edge of a foundation plate from a dungeon's heart. It is warm, as though something is still using it.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Seed-bowl rim
description: The rim of a broken seed bowl. Faint grooves suggest it once held something precious.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Seed-bowl base
description: The base of a broken seed bowl, stained green inside. Whatever grew here grew well.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Primer leaf, first page
description: The first page of an old spell primer, its margins dense with a student's notes.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Primer leaf, second page
description: The second page of an old spell primer. The diagrams here are worn from many fingers.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Primer leaf, binding
description: The binding of an old spell primer, with a few thread-ends still holding. Without it the pages will not sit together.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Humming glass shard
description: A shard of humming glass. It buzzes against your thumb when you hold it near its other half.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Humming glass rim
description: The rim of a humming glass bowl. It rings very faintly when it is near its other half.
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Spark Rune
description: A rune of quick, crackling force. Socket it in a weapon or accessory for a little extra magic attack.
flavor: It crackles when you set it down.

name: Dusk Rune
description: A rune of the hour when lamps are lit. Socket it in armour or an accessory for extra magic defence.
flavor: Dwarves cut it at lamp-lighting hour and swear it keeps the time.

name: Bastion Rune
description: A squat, square rune cut for walls and shields. Socket it in armour for extra defence.
flavor: Square, plain and stubborn. It was never meant to be pretty.

name: Cinder Rune
description: A rune of low, patient heat. Socket it in a weapon for a firm boost to attack.
flavor: Not a flame. The warmth left when one has done its work.

name: Warden Rune
description: A rune of watchfulness, cut by dwarves who guard doors for a living. Socket it in armour or an accessory for extra HP.
flavor: Door-guards carry one. They say it listens when they sleep.

name: Scroll of Rimebrand
description: A scroll rimed with frost. Binds an Ice edge to a weapon and adds a little attack.
flavor: The ink frosts over if you hold it too long.

name: Scroll of Ironhide
description: A heavy-inked scroll of iron grit. Binds to armour for extra defence.
flavor: Dense, dark ink. It weighs more than it should.

name: Scroll of Lanternlight
description: A scroll that glows like a lantern behind paper. Binds to a charm or ring for extra magic attack.
flavor: The page glows a little, as if someone is reading it from the other side.
